name: n64recomp
notes: Builds two CLIs from the repo: bin/N64Recomp (N64 MIPS ELF to C) and bin/RSPRecomp (RSP microcode to C). Built with CMake from a git clone at the pinned commit (no archive, so sha256 is null). test.sh generates a tiny big-endian MIPS ELF and a tiny RSP blob and checks the emitted C for both tools; PASS. Test inputs are self-made; no game data.
